methodology: Checked branch, local HEAD, clean working tree, matching origin branch and source history before review.
Read specification, architecture, budgets, recovery/operator and wire protocols before tracing production implementation.
Formed independent native/cloud/recovery/authority/budget assessment before consulting prior finding registers.
Assessed every previous correction against current source, targeted tests and retained execution identities.
Executed only focused synthetic local tests; inspected retained Android, host-death and historical live evidence without rerunning them.
Separated code defects from unexecuted acceptance coverage and intentional fail-closed availability limits.

evidence_limitations: No new Android build, JVM execution, instrumentation, emulator operation or host force-stop was performed.
Retained hashes and per-suite summaries establish retained evidence identity, not an independent APK rebuild; historical APK binaries were not rehashed.
The native 213-case run precedes the bounded detachment preflight/message follow-up; 52 overlapping controller cases cover that delta. They are not 265 unique native cases.
The 98 selected local results overlap retained suites and are not additive unique coverage.
Independent malformed-input probes cover 22 request variants inside two tests, not exhaustive fuzzing.
Local Miniflare/D1/R2 and provider shims do not prove deployed Cloudflare behavior or CPU.
Historical 6.950 ms p95 was head-heavy and excluded corrected mutation/recovery route coverage; no extrapolation is made.
Existing process-death evidence is host force-stop on isolated fixtures, not power loss or physical-device validation.
Historical UI screenshots are not a current-binary run of every corrected dialog.
Independent hardware, long offline/Doze/OEM behavior, actual paired-relay restore and current cross-component live recovery/replacement remain acceptance work.
Unresolved provider effects intentionally retain tickets/holds and may prevent in-place recovery; this is an explicit availability limit.
Inspection was targeted across the complete architecture; this report does not claim exhaustive exploration of every interleaving.
intended_commit_scope: Only the new review directory, including review metadata, raw local test logs and the documentation-only probe recipe.
